newsitem.title: FINLAND: FEEBLE MARKKA BONDS CONTINUE TO UNDERPERFORM.
newsitem.headline: FEEBLE MARKKA BONDS CONTINUE TO UNDERPERFORM.

text.p: Finnish bonds continued to underperform German Bunds in a market lacking both investor interest and fresh incentives, dealers said.
"We have clearly underperformed Germany lately and it looks like we are set to continue this way for a while," one said.
This week, the 10-year bond's yield gap over Germany widened by nine basis points to 67.
Dealers said the approaching year-end was clearly denting investor interest in bonds.
"It seems as if many investors have already reached their targets for this year," one said.
The markka was steady against the mark in calm trade, with firm resistance at 3.02, forex dealers said.
But they said there was obvious pressure on the markka to weaken more next week.
"The Swedish crown is inching lower against the mark and the dollar is clearly off its highs," one said.
